name: Uttarakhand
tagline: Devbhoomi — Ganga Aarti, Clifftop Hill Stations & Tiger Safaris
shortDescription: White water river rafting in Rishikesh, mesmerizing evening Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat, scenic walks in Mussoorie, and tiger safaris in Jim Corbett.
fullOverview: From the adrenaline rush of Grade IV rapids in Rishikesh and tranquil yoga ashrams along the sacred Ganges to the misty colonial promenades of Mussoorie and Nainital’s emerald lakes, Uttarakhand balances rejuvenation with thrilling mountain wilderness.
bestTime: October to June (Great for rafting & hill stations) | November to February (Jim Corbett tiger safaris & Auli skiing)
highlights: 16 km White Water River Rafting through Shivpuri to Rishikesh with cliff jumping
Soulful sunset Ganga Aarti ceremony at Parmarth Niketan / Triveni Ghat
Open 4x4 Jeep Safari in Jim Corbett National Park (Bijrani / Dhikala zone)
Scenic cable car ride to Gun Hill and Kempty Falls in Mussoorie
Yachting and boating on mango-shaped Naini Lake

howToReach.air: Jolly Grant Airport, Dehradun (DED) with daily direct flights from Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad.
howToReach.road: Smooth 4-5 hour drive from Delhi-NCR via Delhi-Meerut Expressway.

topAttractions.name: Rishikesh & Ganga Riverbank
topAttractions.description: Global capital of Yoga, iconic suspension bridges (Lakshman & Ram Jhula), and cafes.

topAttractions.name: Jim Corbett Tiger Reserve
topAttractions.description: India’s oldest national park known for Royal Bengal Tigers, wild elephants, and rich birdlife.

stayCategories.recommendation: Luxury tents with AC, pool, volleyball, and private river stream access.
Nestled on the banks of Kosi River with naturalist-led birding walks.

travelTips: Corbett safari permits for Dhikala and Bijrani zones open 45 days in advance and sell out rapidly.
River rafting is closed during peak monsoon months (July to mid-September) for safety.

faqs.question: Is Uttarakhand suitable for weekend getaways from Delhi?
faqs.answer: Yes, destinations like Rishikesh, Mussoorie, Jim Corbett, and Nainital are accessible in a 4 to 6-hour drive from Delhi NCR, making them ideal 3D/2N weekend breaks.
